description: This file defines classes for generating code templates and managing plugin blueprint data, including classes for header, source, CMake, JSON, and configuration data. It contains methods for creating code snippets, handling plugin interfaces, and managing plugin lifecycle operations.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: Base class for managing plugin file data, providing methods for key generation, namespace extraction, and comment parsing.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Derived class for generating header file code snippets, including interface entries, includes, inheritance, and notification handling.

classes.name: SourceData
classes.description: Derived class for generating source file code snippets, including plugin methods, notifications, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: CMakeData
classes.description: Class for generating CMake build configuration snippets for the plugin.

classes.name: JSONData
classes.description: Class for generating JSON interface and configuration snippets.

classes.name: ConfData
classes.description: Class for generating plugin configuration code snippets.

methods.name: commentParamnames
methods.description: Parses parameter strings to add comment tags and extract parameter names.

methods.name: resolveFullName
methods.description: Resolves a short interface name to its full namespace-qualified name.

methods.name: dynamic_keys
methods.description: Generates dynamic template keys based on plugin name and current year.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the keywords dictionary for template replacement.
